America.title: UPDATE: Flatbush, Brooklyn building collapse — FDNY and the mayor say two dead and at least 17 injured, including a firefighter
America.location: 1321 Flatbush Avenue, Flatbush, Brooklyn, New York City
America.summary: A three-story multiple-dwelling building at 1321 Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn collapsed into an adjacent construction site; the FDNY says it was called at 4:01 p.m. Wednesday (Nov. 11) and units arrived within a minute to begin search-and-rescue operations; Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore said multiple people from the building and the construction site were trapped and called it a prolonged operation. Mayor Zohran Mamdani says two people died and at least 17 others were injured, including one firefighter. NYC Emergency Management opened a reception center for affected residents with the Red Cross at the Flatbush YMCA, and NYPD asked the public to avoid the Bedford Avenue and Flatbush Avenue area.
America.status: Official statement issued (FDNY, Mayor); search and rescue continued into the night; cause not established in official posts checked

Africa.summary: A large power outage hit many Casablanca neighborhoods and nearby localities on Wednesday afternoon (Nov. 11), starting around 5 p.m. local time, according to Yabiladi, Le Desk, Maroc Hebdo and state broadcaster SNRT. Europe.status: Official police updates relayed by STV, The Herald and LBC; injuries' severity not detailed; terrorism claims unverified and not supported by police statements found; carried forward from 10:15 PM ET, no newer change found

The suspected gunman was later found dead in a room of the Elbphilharmonie hotel. Police are examining a link to two people found dead in Eningen, Baden-Württemberg.
Europe.status: Suspect dead; two injured; link to Eningen deaths under investigation per established German and Austrian outlets; no Hamburg police post on the incident found on X; no indication of terrorism found; carried forward from 10:15 PM ET, no newer change found

Europe.title: CONTINUATION: Suspected drones from Belarus cross Lithuania; red air alerts, Kaunas Airport briefly suspends operations, NATO jets scrambled; alerts later lifted
Europe.location: Lithuania (Druskininkai, Lazdijai and other southern districts; Kaunas) and Latvia
Europe.summary: Lithuania issued red air-attack warnings for several southern districts, including Druskininkai and Lazdijai, after unidentified objects, most likely drones, entered from Belarus, and NATO jets were scrambled from Šiauliai. Mario Nawfal, citing Lithuania's National Crisis Management Centre, says four objects were tracked, three of them in Latvian airspace, and that they were likely Ukrainian drones headed for St. Petersburg. Several accounts cite broadcaster LRT as saying Kaunas Airport suspended operations. Lithuania lifted all air alerts early on Nov. 11 local time after a suspected drone crossed the country and flew into Latvia, the head of the crisis centre told LRT radio, according to thetect0nic citing BNS. No shootdown has been reported.
Europe.status: Official alerts issued (Lithuanian Armed Forces and National Crisis Management Centre, as relayed by OSINT and news accounts); alerts lifted early Nov. 11 local time; no damage or casualties reported; Kaunas Airport suspension relayed from LRT, not seen directly from the airport; drone origin unconfirmed; carried forward from 10:15 PM ET, no newer change found

threats.title: CONTINUATION: US indictment of three Iranian-backed operatives over nearly 20 plots — prosecutors say suspects planned to use fuel-carrying vans near RAF Fairford before UK authorities intervened
threats.location: United States; Europe; RAF Fairford, Gloucestershire, England
threats.summary: The Justice Department says an eight-count superseding indictment unsealed Nov. 10 charges three Iranian-backed operatives with terrorism-related offenses over nearly 20 attacks and attempted attacks in the U.S. and Europe. The charges include a September 2026 plot at RAF Fairford in the UK, where U.S. military aircraft and personnel are stationed. The FBI's New York and Washington field offices announced the case. This is a legal action on past plots, not a new attack.
threats.status: Official statement issued (Justice Department, FBI); charges are allegations; defendants presumed innocent; carried forward from 10:15 PM ET, no newer change found
